lines.text: // This Arduino code has been written by Univeristy Of Cincinnati Student Hamza Al Halabi [Alhalaha] for use in Circuits BME2081C for Summer of 2026 This code runs in parallel with Processing to create visual outputs including audio, light, and graphic representation Enjoy!

// FILENAME: Alhalaha_ECG_Monitor.ino Based on EXAMPLE02_Sample.ino (Orlando S. Hoilett, Ph.D.) Reads ECG analog input from Ninetales board and transmits values over Serial to Processing for real-time visualization & beat detection.
// ECG Channel Pin (A2 is default for EXG/ECG on Ninetales, A1 can also be used) const int ECG_PIN = A1;
// Initialize serial communication at 9600 baud for smooth plotting Serial.begin(9600); }
// Read the analog signal from Ninetales (0 to 1023) int ecgSignal = analogRead(ECG_PIN);
// Send raw value over Serial Serial.println(ecgSignal);
// 10ms delay gives ~100 Hz sampling rate, ideal for ECG capture delay(10); }
